research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Capsule8 is researching and developing interactive shell event detection for Linux environments. The work described in 'Interactive shell event detection' involves receiving telemetry related to Exec() events, determining if a process is a shell, and gathering further information about the invoked program. This research focuses on monitoring and analyzing shell activity to enhance attack protection in Linux production systems, including containerized, virtualized, and bare-metal deployments.

overview_description.description: Founded in fall 2016 and headquartered in New York, NY, Capsule8 is the only company protecting enterprise infrastructure with detection and resilience for Linux systems in any environment – whether containerized, virtualized, or bare metal. Capsule8 Protect is defining modern enterprise protection by finding and stopping attacks and other unwanted activity on Linux systems.Founded by experienced hackers and seasoned security entrepreneurs, and funded by Bessemer Venture Partners, ClearSky and Intel Capital, Capsule8 is making it possible for Linux-powered enterprises to modernize without compromise. Learn more at www.Capsule8.com.
